hero.headline: I write software
hero.intro: I'm Thomas. I build open tools for language, knowledge, and the web — JSON Resume, Mob Translate, Donto — and write about what I learn along the way.

projects.name: JSON Resume
projects.description: The original open standard for resumes, in JSON. Themes, hosting, and a whole ecosystem.

projects.name: Mob Translate
projects.description: A living dictionary and translator for Australian Aboriginal languages, built in the open.

projects.name: Donto
projects.description: An evidence substrate for claims, sources, contradictions, and time.

projects.name: Omega
projects.description: A self-editing Discord agent that lives across chat and a persistent world.
